subject.title: Improve release candidate validation reuse and recovery

question: Should the linked PR’s combined candidate-checkpoint, trusted exact-SHA evidence-reuse, CI transition-watching, and Testbox-fingerprinting design become the canonical beta and stable release workflow?
rationale: Current main does not solve the operational problem, but permanent state location, trusted evidence producers, and fail-closed drift boundaries determine release authorization and require maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the combined design
options.body: Review the linked PR as the canonical implementation and require interrupted-resume plus publish-time revalidation proof before landing.

options.title: Stage narrower increments
options.body: Land exact-SHA evidence reuse and candidate checkpointing first, then separate CI watching and Testbox freshness into focused follow-ups.

options.title: Retain fresh-only validation
options.body: Keep full validation restarts and decline durable reuse until maintainers approve a smaller trust model.

recommendation.title: Adopt the combined design
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR as the canonical implementation and require interrupted-resume plus publish-time revalidation proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the assigned issue owner, the candidate implementation author, and a frequent contributor to the affected release and Testbox paths.
